eval_substrate_preflight.note: a floor-hitting eval series must be rejected before any Outcome is opened; this confirms the Judge can execute, it does not change the Judge

first_fault.note: One bad result is enough to open the diagnosis and is not enough to authorize a General clause; the per-clause evidence threshold is applied at the Slow stage, on distinct Task counts.

slow_response.new_guidance: Supply only minimal effect-distinct candidates justified by public evidence. When a candidate contains repair_level_shift and post_shift_support_sufficient is true, rank it below otherwise comparable minimal candidates that do not contain repair_level_shift. Do not make this a blanket prohibition or add context-specific exceptions.

archive_status.label: NO_SOURCE_EXPERIENCE_BASELINE
archive_status.what_it_establishes: the full Pipeline closes on a second cohort, and it is the paired baseline against which the Source Experience inlet is measured: both arms ran with an empty Source package on every Task
archive_status.what_it_does_not_establish: any A5-over-A3 advantage. With no Source package delivered, the two arms differ only by their own accumulated Episodes and sampling; task_01 inputs were byte-identical.
archive_status.guidance_used: h0 base, both arms, no patch
archive_status.confound_to_avoid_next_round: this round's Slow wrote a clause deprioritizing repair_level_shift from electricity Outcomes. Reusing it would let General guidance pre-empt the decision the Source Episodes are supposed to inform, so the next round starts from h0 with fresh state roots.
